title: Why can't I block this user?
summary: Explains why blocking a user may fail: maximum block list limit of $275, duplicate/similar name already on the block list, ineligible profile due to account status/compliance restrictions, username/profile mismatch, or a temporary service issue. Suggests removing entries, verifying the profile, and contacting support with an error screenshot.
faqs: Why does it say I can’t block this user—did I hit a limit?
